verdict.rationale: Motion's own feature page says users can embed its AI Calendar on their website so prospects can book time slots, which is a first-party booking embed. That is the only evidence: one marketing mention, with no developer documentation of how the embed works. missing for 10: documented embed snippet/code, inline vs popup vs floating widget modes, developer-facing embed docs or configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the booking experience in my own site — inline, popup, or floating widget — with a documented snippet

citations.quote: Share your schedule anywhere—embed Motion's AI Calendar on your website so prospects can book your ideal time slots instantly.
